observations: Product listTickets() currently caps ~100 rows then filters in memory — search cannot see tickets beyond the cap.
At 10k tickets, full client/server in-memory scan of the full set is possible in Node but not exposed by API.
Multi-country stores in this synthetic set are not enforced by DB constraints in initial schema.
N+1 risk: ticket detail loads messages/events; list pages should avoid per-row detail fetches.

bottlenecks.detail: In-memory filter after limit=100 makes search/filters incomplete at scale.
No DB ilike/indexed search path for ticket number/store/description.
Synthetic cross-country rows possible; schema lacks same-country enforcement.
